config.sandboxVitestSkipNeedsPs: ^(?!readProcessStartMs reads the real start time of a live process$)

scripts.check: npm run -s check:backend && npm run -s frontend:typecheck && npm run -s check:frontend-test
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && if [ "$CEZ_CHECK_SANDBOX" = 1 ]; then export GOCACHE="$PWD/../.cache/go-build" GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE="$PWD/../.cache/golangci-lint" GOPROXY="file://$(go env GOMODCACHE)/cache/download" GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-p=4; set -- -skip "^($npm_package_config_sandboxGoSkipNeedsBinary|$npm_package_config_sandboxGoSkipNeedsPs)$"; fi && go test "$@" ./... && go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.14.0 run --path-mode=abs
scripts.check:frontend-test: if [ "$CEZ_CHECK_SANDBOX" = 1 ]; then export HOME="$PWD/.cache/check-home" && mkdir -p "$HOME"; set -- --exclude "$npm_package_config_sandboxVitestExcludeNeedsElectron" -t "$npm_package_config_sandboxVitestSkipNeedsPs"; fi && npm --prefix frontend test -- "$@"
scripts.lint: cd backend && go test ./... && go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.14.0 run --path-mode=abs
scripts.cloud:check: npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/cloud-client/src/schema.ts && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client test && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run build
scripts.product-ui:check: npm --prefix packages/product-ui run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/product-ui test && npm --prefix packages/product-ui run build
scripts.shared:check: npm run cloud:check && npm run product-ui:check
scripts.sqlc: cd backend && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.31.1 generate
scripts.api: npm run api:spec && npm run api:ts
